assets.title: Lena Delta
assets.caption: Lena River Delta, captured by Landsat 7 on 27 July 2000. USGS / NASA, public domain: https://www.usgs.gov/media/images/lena-delta. Real false-color satellite imagery, cropped and flipped vertically for the fromearth / 2050 campaign; no AI generation. The colors do not represent temperatures or a 2050 climate projection.

assets.title: Layered climate
assets.caption: The same region appears as a flat geographic footprint and native temperature meshes for the 2026 and 2050 views. Height encodes hottest-month mean daily maximum temperature (°C), using the same scale. Values use the experience’s WorldClim/CMIP6 grid and year interpolation: MPI-ESM1-2-HR, SSP3-7.0. These are modeled climate estimates; height does not represent terrain elevation.
